name: techquest
description: TechQuest — an interactive technology & AI learning platform for children aged 8–12.

scripts.predev: npm run build -w @techquest/shared && npm run generate -w @techquest/db
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @techquest/shared" "npm run dev -w @techquest/api" "npm run dev -w @techquest/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @techquest/shared && npm run build -w @techquest/db && npm run build -w @techquest/api && npm run build -w @techquest/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @techquest/shared && npm run generate -w @techquest/db && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @techquest/shared && npm run generate -w @techquest/db && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
